specs.source_title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0 - PLA Matte
specs.locator: p.1 › Recommended Printing Settings › Drying Settings before Printing
specs.quote: Drying Settings before Printing Blast Drying Oven: 50 °C，8 h
specs.note: Alternative in the same cell: "X1 Series Printer Heatbed: 60 - 70 °C, 12 h". Printing and Storage Humidity: "< 20% RH (Sealed with desiccant)". The wiki drying guide (Appendix I, row "PLA Basic / PLA Matte") agrees: forced-air oven 50 ℃ for 8 h, heatbed 60-70 ℃ for 12 h, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT 45 ℃ for 12 h. The wiki material table's generic "PLA" row says 55 ℃ for 8 h; the product's own TDS value is kept.

specs.source_title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0 - PLA Matte
specs.locator: p.1 › Recommended Printing Settings › Drying Settings before Printing

specs.note: The wiki drying guide (row "PLA Basic / PLA Matte") agrees: 50 ℃ for 8 h in a forced-air oven; heatbed 60-70 ℃ for 12 h; AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT 45 ℃ for 12 h.

specs.locator: p.2 › 1 - Identification › Product identifier › Model

specs.note: The SDS model designation, "xx" standing for any suffix; every SKU code in the manifest row begins A01- (e.g. A01-K1-1.75-1000-SPLFREE).

specs.value: All standard nozzles are compatible (no special restrictions); all printers compatible; fully compatible with the AMS series.
specs.source_title: PLA Usage Guide
specs.locator: 1.1 Hardware compatibility › row "PLA Basic / Matte / Translucent / Tough+ / Lite/ Metal"
specs.quote: PLA Basic / Matte / Translucent / Tough+ / Lite/ Metal | All standard nozzles are compatible (no special restrictions) | All printers compatible | Fully compatible with the AMS series
specs.note: The row names PLA Matte. The store page FAQ agrees: "Compatible with all printers, AMS, build plate, and nozzles."

specs.source_title: PLA Matte (store page)
specs.locator: Product Features › bullet 3; components[3] (UL GREENGUARD block)
specs.quote: Low indoor printing emissions, certified to UL GREENGUARD 2904
specs.note: Store-page prose only (a feature bullet and a description block: "PLA Matte is certified to UL GREENGUARD (UL 2904)"); no certificate document for it was among the cached documents, so it stays unverified. The TDS and SDS state no certification. The page also links RoHS, SVHC, PAHs, TSCA, POPs, CP65 and EN71-3 reports, which were not cached and not read.
